title: Individual tree crowns per island, from a 1 m canopy height model

frame.description: Course frame of scripts/layline-bake-venue.mjs: ENU metres about the venue origin, rotated so +y runs up the course axis. 1 unit = 1 m.
frame.verticalNote: z is the source file's own elevation, orthometric metres, unshifted.

method: Variable-window local maxima on a smoothed 1 m CHM (surface max-z minus hole-filled class 2/20 ground). Crown radius grown to the 40%-of-top contour, then clamped at half the nearest-neighbour distance, so it is a lower bound. Crowns standing inside a detected mass are dropped as screen panels and rig structure.
tolerance: Crown count is good to roughly a factor of three (594 raw, 268 at smoothing radius 1, 170 at radius 2 on Island White); the height distribution is not sensitive to the same sweep. Placing crowns at measured positions and heights is supported; an exact census is not.

vintage.caveat: Island planting turns over on a scale of years, so a specific crown may no longer be there; the canopy statistics will be.

inputs.note: Every raw file behind these numbers is listed with its sha256, URL and retrieval date in provenance.json. The digests here pin the exact sets this product read: listSha256 is sha256 over the sorted `<sha256>\t<file>` lines.
